units.source_text: 正在此时，宫中派使者来了，报道：“明石皇后今天傍晚忽然心痛，此刻病势甚重。”

en.t: Just then, a messenger came from the palace and reported, "Empress Akashi was suddenly seized with chest pain this evening, and her condition is now very grave."

units.source_text: 右近悄悄地对少将君说：“在这尴尬的时候生起病来，真不巧啊！

en.t: Ukon quietly said to Lady Shosho, "How unfortunate that illness should arise at such an awkward moment!
I will go and deliver the message."

units.source_text: 少将君说：“不要去吧，这时候你去传达，徒劳无益，太不知趣了。

en.t: Lady Shosho said, "You had better not go. If you deliver it now, it will do no good and would be terribly tactless.
You must not disturb them too much."

units.source_text: 右近说：“不要紧，现在还没有成那事。”

en.t: Ukon said, "It is all right. Things have not gone that far yet."

units.source_text: 二女公子听见了，想道：“此人有此种恶习，说出去多难听啊！

en.t: The second young lady heard this and thought, "If people learn that he has such a bad habit, how disgraceful it will sound!

units.source_text: 稍具戒心的人，连我这里也不敢来了。”

en.t: Anyone with the slightest caution would not even dare come to me anymore."

units.source_text: 右近便去向匂亲王报告，把使者的话加以夸张。

en.t: Ukon then went to report to Prince Niou, exaggerating the messenger's words.

units.source_text: 匂亲王听了不动声色，问道：“来的是谁？

en.t: Prince Niou heard this without changing expression and asked, "Who has come?

units.source_text: 又要大惊小怪地来恐吓我了。”

en.t: They have come making another great fuss to frighten me."

units.source_text: 右近答道：“是皇后的侍臣，名叫平重经的。”

en.t: Ukon answered, "It is one of the Empress's attendants, a man named Taira no Shigetsune."

units.source_text: 匂亲王舍不得离开浮舟，竟不顾旁人耳目，一直呆在这里。

en.t: Prince Niou could not bear to leave Ukifune, and, disregarding what others might see or hear, he remained there all the while.

units.source_text: 右近只得出去，把使者叫到这西室前面来，向他探问情况。

en.t: Ukon had no choice but to go out, call the messenger to the front of the western room, and ask him about the situation.

units.source_text: 刚才传达使者的话的人也来了。

en.t: The person who had earlier relayed the messenger's words also came.

units.source_text: 使者报道：“中务亲王也已入宫去了。

en.t: The messenger reported, "Prince Nakatsukasa has already gone into the palace as well.

units.source_text: 中宫大夫刚刚动身，小人在路上遇见他的车驾的。”

en.t: The Intendant of the Empress's Household has just set out, and I met his carriage on the road."

units.source_text: 匂亲王想起皇后确是常常突然生病的，今天如果不去，深恐惹人非议，

en.t: Prince Niou remembered that the Empress did indeed often fall suddenly ill, and he feared that if he did not go today, he would invite severe criticism,

units.source_text: 便向浮舟说了许多怨言，订了后会之期，然后离去。

en.t: so he said many reproachful things to Ukifune, arranged a time to meet again, and then left.
